exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal, operative vaginal, cesarean section)
Women with OL/PL/FTP who gave birth vaginally
cohort: Pregnant women enrolled during pregnancy and followed up for 6 weeks after delivery
finding: Women with obstructed labor, prolonged labor, or failure to progress (OL/PL/FTP) were more likely to experience adverse maternal, fetal, and neonatal outcomes, including death, hemorrhage, and infection.
mod_finding: Women with OL/PL/FTP who had unassisted vaginal deliveries had a higher risk of adverse outcomes compared to those who had operative vaginal deliveries or cesarean sections.
country: Argentina, Guatemala, India (Belgaum and Nagpur), Kenya, Pakistan, and Zambia
